reviews.text: Brilliant service and the ladys always do there best to help and do the best job possible

Been using pampered paws since I got my puppy! He is normally very anxious and cry’s or barks when I leave him but when I leave him at pampered paws he is absolutely fine and actually loves going! The girls are just amazing with him, he always comes out looking amazing and smelling lushh! Girls are so nice and always really helpful! Would 100% recommend,  x
